concerns.text: The plan assumes 1 500 inference calls (500 commits × 3 models) each completing within the NFR‑001 budget of ≤60 s on a GitHub Actions free‑tier runner (2 CPU, ~7 GB RAM). Even with 4‑bit quantization, a 3 B‑parameter model typically exceeds 60 s per generation on such hardware, leading to a total wall‑clock time far beyond the allowed CI runtime (≈25 h). The fallback “GPU escape hatch” only reduces the sample to the first 200 commits for offending models, but the overall pipeline still risks exceeding both CPU and Kaggle free‑GPU limits. This makes the proposed compute strategy infeasible under the project’s free‑compute constraints.
